instruction: Run `C:\\Users\\User\\Desktop\\bjt_ref.cir` in native PSpice. Keep the native simulator artifacts as `C:\\Users\\User\\Desktop\\bjt_ref.out`, `C:\\Users\\User\\Desktop\\bjt_ref_measure.txt`, and `C:\\Users\\User\\Desktop\\bjt_ref.dat`. Then export the six native temperature points from `C:\\Users\\User\\Desktop\\bjt_ref_measure.txt` into `C:\\Users\\User\\Desktop\\t_curve.csv`. The CSV header must be `T_C,Vout_V`, and the rows must be listed in increasing temperature order.
source: PSpice native temperature sweep of a transistor-based BJT reference string
